elements.description: A stacked bar chart with a linked table: pick the measure, the slice and the segment; legend chips hide segments.

properties.name: heading
properties.description: The heading, and the region's name

properties.name: fill
properties.description: Grow to the container's width instead of stopping at 560px

properties.name: records
properties.description: The rows to chart – one object per item, with a value for each dimension key and each measure field

properties.name: dimensions
properties.description: The fields people can slice and segment by, with their values in display order

properties.name: measures
properties.description: What the bars can measure – a count of records, or the sum of a field

properties.name: measure
properties.description: Measure key; unset is the first measure

properties.name: slice
properties.description: Dimension key the bars are sliced by; unset is the first dimension

properties.name: segment
properties.description: Dimension key the bars are segmented by, or "none" for single-color bars; unset is the second dimension

properties.name: hiddenSegments
properties.description: Segment values hidden from the bars and totals; picking another segment clears it (`hidden` is the HTML attribute)

properties.name: look
properties.description: Visual style: "standard" or "clean"; unset follows <tc-look-provider>, else "standard"

events.name: tc-measure-change
events.description: The measure was picked; detail `{ measure: string }`. Cancelable (controlled use)

events.name: tc-slice-change
events.description: The slice dimension was picked; detail `{ slice: string }`. Cancelable

events.name: tc-segment-change
events.description: The segment dimension was picked ("none" for single-color bars); detail `{ segment: string }`. Cancelable

events.name: tc-hidden-change
events.description: Segment values were hidden or shown; detail `{ hidden: string[] }`. Cancelable

functions.name: breakdownStatusIcon
functions.signature: breakdownStatusIcon({ kind, color = "currentColor", look }: { kind: BreakdownStatusKind; color?: string; look?: Look }): SVGSVGElement
functions.description: A small status icon element, for a dimension's `icons`. Without `look` it takes the chart's look

props.name: records
props.description: The rows to chart – one object per item, with a value for each dimension key and each measure field

props.name: dimensions
props.description: The fields people can slice and segment by; `icons` takes React nodes

props.name: measures
props.description: What the bars can measure – a count of records, or the sum of a field

props.name: title
props.description: The heading, and the region's name (default "Workload")

props.name: measure
props.description: Measure key (controlled). Leave undefined and use `defaultMeasure` to let the chart keep it

props.name: defaultMeasure
props.description: The measure picked at first, when `measure` is not controlled – defaults to the first

props.name: onMeasureChange
props.description: Called when another measure is picked

props.name: slice
props.description: Dimension key the bars are sliced by (controlled)

props.name: defaultSlice
props.description: The slice picked at first, when `slice` is not controlled – defaults to the first dimension

props.name: onSliceChange
props.description: Called when another slice is picked

props.name: segment
props.description: Dimension key the bars are segmented by, or "none" for single-color bars (controlled)

props.name: defaultSegment
props.description: The segment picked at first, when `segment` is not controlled – defaults to the second dimension

props.name: onSegmentChange
props.description: Called when another segment is picked

props.name: hidden
props.description: Segment values hidden from the bars and totals (controlled); picking another segment clears it

props.name: defaultHidden
props.description: The segment values hidden at first, when `hidden` is not controlled

props.name: onHiddenChange
props.description: Called when legend chips hide or show segment values, or Show all is pressed

features.name: light-dark()
features.why: Every colour token is a light / dark pair; without it no colour token resolves.

features.name: color-mix()
features.why: Tints and washes mixed from the tokens.

features.name: Container size queries
features.why: Components adapt to the width they're given, not the window's.

features.name: :is() and :where()
features.why: Every rule is keyed on :where() so the page can override it.

features.name: scrollbar-width
features.without: Scrollbars keep the browser's default width.

features.name: adoptedStyleSheets
features.without: Each element type's CSS goes into one <style> element in <head> instead – it looks and works the same.

features.name: forced-colors media query
features.without: In a forced-colours mode the browser's own adjustments apply, without the components' fixes.
